# Brandhorst–Shimada Enriques source

*Automorphism Groups of Certain Enriques Surfaces*, Foundations of Computational Mathematics 22 (2022), 1463–1512:
[DOI](https://doi.org/10.1007/s10208-021-09530-y), arXiv 2012.10622.
The pinned [author preprint](https://home.hiroshima-u.ac.jp/ichiro-shimada/preprints/AutEnrVol/paper/AutEnrVol.pdf)
was retrieved on 2026-08-08 as `AutEnrVol.pdf` (302435 bytes).
SHA-256: `e11f06d376996bbb2aa3221c6e67ac82a9fa99e9e56096ebc35279cf206e610b`.

The historical Type-II route uses Definition 1.1 and Propositions 1.2–1.3,
Table 1.1, row 184, Definition 1.4(ii) and Section 7.4. These identify the
`D9(-2)` anti-lattice and the 12B chamber; they do not identify chosen lifts
curve by curve. Sheet-switch uniqueness is a separate project argument.

The version of record is CC-BY-4.0. This pinned author-preprint copy is not
relicensed here. [Detailed scope](https://sashakolpakov.github.io/CoxeterPolytopes/sources.html#brandhorst-shimada)
and [retrieval](../../../repro/EXTERNAL_INPUTS.md) distinguish source bytes,
geometric inputs and compiler conclusions.
